calibration: Compare trace with same-build ordinary, check against exact 946 frozen. Summarize solver and full paired observer drift.
scope: Capture timestamps of the same 256 certified spans and their 28 original tasks while preserving the normal parallel schedule. Probe both four and seven pinned solver workers.
chronology: Each span records first-round state ready, completion of 25 and 50 of the remaining 75 S-box writes, and whole tail completion. Every timestamp is elapsed nanoseconds plus one from the beginning of solver instruction execution. Task entry and exit bracket each span.
